animations.name: Heavy Kick Low Sweep
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE continuous 360-degree spinning low sweep in ONE direction only (NEVER reverse direction), pure solid body motion in empty air: staying compact and centered low on the baseline, Oscar plants one hand on the floor as center pivot and spins in ONE uninterrupted 360-degree turn—from facing RIGHT, turning his BACK to camera while sweeping his right leg forward-right just above the floor, continuing the same spin to face LEFT, then turning his FRONT to camera, and finishing back facing RIGHT in the starting kneeling crouch guard pose. Keep the sweeping leg compact so both sneakers stay well inside 512x512 with wide margin on left and right edges. Preserve Oscar's face, solid black outfit, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
